name: Environment Link fixer
description: Strips mapped/production domain names from absolute links and images so URLs become relative and resolve on the current environment.
project_description: Environment Link fixer removes mapped domain names from absolute URLs so that content authored with a hard-coded environment domain (for example a production hostname) renders as relative/internal links that resolve on whatever environment is currently serving the page. It ships three pieces that all share the same helper functions in env_link_fixer.module: a text-format filter (id env_link_fixer_strip_domain) that rewrites and in filtered HTML, a link field widget (env_link_fixer_link_widget) that strips the current base URL host on save, and a link field formatter (env_link_fixer_link_formatter) that can force absolute URLs on configured local domains to relative at display time. Domain mappings are configured at /admin/config/system/env_link_fixer (config object env_link_fixer.settings, key 'mapping', format 'hostname|domain,domain'), and can be extended or disabled per environment from settings.php via $settings['env_link_fixer_custom_mappings'] and $settings['env_link_fixer_disabled']. The current hostname is read from the request. The module adds no entities, services or Drush commands.
